normalization.title: The Machine Is Learning to Improve the Machine
normalization.overview: GPT-6.2 Astra's High AI Self-Improvement classification concerns AI-assisted research. A persistent fixed-model coding factory is a separate feedback loop; neither alone confers autonomous production authority.
normalization.whyItMatters: Conflating research capability, software iteration and release approval hides where independent evidence and human accountability remain necessary.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Let agents inspect, propose and test within bounded scopes; require independent operational acceptance, explicit release authority and rollback before production changes.
